mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_facility (name, type, location, quantity, maintainer, last_check, next_check, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{type}, #{location}, #{quantity}, #{maintainer}, #{lastCheck}, #{nextCheck}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS normal, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS needRepair, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checking FROM t_facility
